flagshipProject.name: ArthSetu — Distributed Digital Banking Platform
flagshipProject.tagline: A production-grade digital banking backend core built with Java 21, Spring Boot 3.3.5, and Apache Kafka. Implements Saga choreography, Redisson distributed locks, idempotency engines, and automated compensating transactions.

overview.problem: Traditional monolithic banking systems struggle with tight coupling, database-level lock contention during simultaneous transfers, and cascading failures across services. In fintech transfers, simple HTTP calls risk silent failure mid-flight, potentially causing catastrophic double-debiting or un-refunded funds when downstream credit endpoints fail.
overview.approach: Designed a multi-module distributed banking core using Hexagonal Architecture and Saga choreography across Apache Kafka. Instead of blocking 2-Phase Commit (2PC) or an orchestrator single-point-of-failure, each service manages its own isolated PostgreSQL database and communicates via durable Kafka events with automated compensating transactions (refunds).
overview.outcome: Built an end-to-end resilient banking system with zero double-debiting guarantees through Redisson distributed locking and REST idempotency keys, validated by 37 passing automated tests.

engineeringDecisions.rationale: An orchestrator is a single point of failure and tightly couples services. With choreography, services react independently to Kafka events. If Transaction Service temporarily restarts, Account Service still processes from its partition without data loss.

Redisson distributed lock (wait 5s, lease 10s) prevents two simultaneous transfer requests across multiple instances from passing balance verification. JPA @Version protects low-level database consistency. They address two distinct failure modes.

engineeringDecisions.decision: Direct @Modifying JPQL UPDATE over JPA Entity Save
engineeringDecisions.rationale: JPA's EntityManager caches entities in its first-level persistence context. When an HTTP thread loads an account entity while a Kafka consumer thread tries to save the same entity ID concurrently, JPA throws NonUniqueObjectException. Direct UPDATE statements bypass EntityManager cache staleness entirely.

With symmetric HS256, all microservices share the same secret key — compromising one service allows forged admin tokens. With RS256, only Auth Service holds private.pem. API Gateway and downstream services hold public.pem; they verify authenticity but can never forge tokens.

When a @Transactional method encounters an exception, Spring marks the physical transaction as rollback-only. @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW) guarantees an independent physical transaction so compensating refunds execute in a clean transaction boundary.

engineeringDecisions.decision: Resilience4j Circuit Breaker with 4xx Client Bypass
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Feign calls from Transaction to Account Service are wrapped in Resilience4j. Business validation errors (e.g., 403 ownership mismatch, 422 insufficient funds) are explicitly treated as client validation exceptions rather than infrastructure faults, preventing circuit breakers from falsely tripping open.

otherProjects.name: TruthTrace: AI-Powered Misinformation Detection Platform
otherProjects.tagline: End-to-end full-stack platform helping users assess online claims and news screenshots through a documented OCR and NLP analysis workflow with persistent history.

overview.problem: Online misinformation spreads rapidly across social media as both raw text posts and screenshots of fabricated news. Ordinary users lack straightforward tools to extract text from images, assess claim credibility, and inspect automated assessment rationale without misleading binary conclusions.
overview.approach: Engineered a layered architecture combining a React single-page frontend and a modular Spring Boot REST API. Integrated Tesseract OCR for screenshot text extraction with user verification before NLP analysis, persisting results in MySQL with explicit distinction between model confidence and objective factual truth.
overview.outcome: Designed an auditable verification workflow supporting text submissions and image uploads, with structured results dashboards, user history management, and automated test coverage.

otherProjects.name: LifeLedger: Secure Student Productivity Platform
otherProjects.tagline: A student-centric productivity platform combining JWT-secured Spring Boot backend services with task tracking, milestone management, and habit consistency analytics.

overview.problem: Students manage fragmented commitments across disconnected apps for coursework, deadlines, habits, and long-term milestones, often encountering bloated tools that lack clean data modeling and reliable user data isolation.
overview.approach: Built a monolithic layered Spring Boot backend with clean relational MySQL modeling, user ownership validation on every endpoint, JWT-secured sessions, and dedicated domain modules for tasks, habits, and goals.
overview.outcome: Delivered a cohesive student workspace computing daily agendas, milestone progress, and habit streaks directly from persisted relational data without synthetic statistics.

modules.title: Authentication & User Management
modules.description: User registration, BCrypt password hashing, JWT token lifecycle management, user role enforcement, and duplicate account validation.

modules.title: Academic Task & Assignment Tracking
modules.description: CRUD operations with priorities, categories, due date tracking, overdue status detection, and relational user ownership constraints.

modules.title: Goals & Milestone Engine
modules.description: Hierarchical goal breakdown into actionable milestones, computing real-time progress percentages strictly from completed milestone records.

modules.title: Habit & Routine Tracker
modules.description: Daily completion logs, consecutive streak calculation, and weekly/monthly habit heatmaps with consistent date boundary handling.

modules.title: Dashboard & Insights
modules.description: Centralized overview of today's schedule, overdue assignments, habit streaks, and goal completions derived purely from stored database records.

modules.title: Backend Layering & Integrity
modules.description: Strict separation between controllers, service logic, and Spring Data JPA repositories, preventing unauthorized cross-user data leakage.
